code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with lymphopenia and neutropenia, and mild hypoalbuminemia. Elevated INR suggests coagulopathy. Inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin) are elevated. Mild hypoglycemia and low ALT/CK are noted. Findings are consistent with acute or chronic illness, possible infection or inflammation, and increased bleeding risk. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
